Take current 512-character slice from the exact frozen 5120-character prefix and require its authoritative SHA-256.
Create current chunk with O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW mode 0400; write, flush, fsync, close; then lstat/readback/rehash.
Append exactly one compact sorted-key CHUNK_ACCEPTED event using O_WRONLY|O_APPEND|O_NOFOLLOW; fsync; reread and require exact full sequence before progressing.
